data.desc: Greenland Mines Ltd is a Nasdaq-listed resource development and mining company focused on the advancement of the Skaergaard Project in southeast Greenland and the Sarfartoq neodymium-praseodymium rare earths project in southwest Greenland. The Company's strategy is centered on building a multi-asset platform with exposure to rare earth magnet materials, precious metals and critical minerals, while advancing its North Atlantic Critical Metals Corridor vision linking Greenlandic resources with processing, infrastructure and end markets in allied jurisdictions.
